# Slash commands (generated)

Every command the line REPL accepts, projected from
`COMMAND_REGISTRY` (`internal/commands/registry.go`) — the same table that drives the
`/help` ordering, so this cannot describe a command that does not exist
or omit one that does.

Both surfaces serve these. The `host --stdio` protocol does not parse slash
text — an embedding host owns its own composer and sends a resolved command as a
protocol frame — but the catalog it offers IS this table, handed over in
`host:ready`, and the frame is answered from the same registry. So a command
added here appears in the native palette with no change on the host side.

**Do not edit this file** — it is regenerated and diffed in CI.
